execution_reason: Direct human request to run a linear probe after the eight frozen-encoder prototype-head fits
scope: Exactly four already frozen encoder caches crossed with Raw and Log matrix maps; eight unique CPU-only convex linear probes

data.pool: Original 5230-image TRAIN pool only, existing partition0
data.fit_augmentation: Uniform weight on both already cached real RGB flip states, 8368 rows; this is a new fixed empirical risk, not replay of old stochastic flip frequencies

matrix_definition.C0: Existing .95 sample covariance + .05 trace(sample covariance)/32 I, cached float32 without epsilon
matrix_definition.C: C0 + float32(1e-4) I in float32, exactly once
matrix_definition.log: Symmetric float64 eigh and log, strictly positive spectrum, reconstruct and cast float32; no floor or extra jitter
matrix_definition.probe_precision: Convert mapped matrices to float64 before svec, scaling, and convex optimization
matrix_definition.svec: Upper triangle32x32 (528 coordinates), offdiagonal times sqrt2, preserving Frobenius inner product

scaler.fit_scope: 8368 TRAIN augmented rows only, separately per view and cell
scaler.scale: One scalar per view: sqrt(mean over TRAIN augmented rows of squared centered L2 norm)); average centered feature energy becomes1
scaler.held_rule: Apply frozen TRAIN mean and scalar only
scaler.limit: Equal total energy does not equalize feature directions or make induced L2 priors identical

classifier.definition: Two independent affine linear logits z_v=X_v W_v+b_v; dual logits=(z_0+z_1)/2
classifier.initialization: All W and b exactly zero, no head randomness

optimizer.name: SciPy L-BFGS-B, no constraints, analytic full-batch float64 gradient
optimizer.acceptance: Independently recomputed full regularized gradient L2 norm <=1e-6; solver success flag alone is insufficient
optimizer.on_nonconvergence: Retain actual endpoint and stop remaining queue, no restart or retry

secondary_matched_fit.selection: First accepted optimizer iterate including step0 below each threshold; no interpolation, NOT_REACHED retained
secondary_matched_fit.held_use: Evaluate retained snapshots only after optimization ends; never select a point using held
secondary_matched_fit.limit: Matching mean TRAIN CE does not equalize margins, objective, compute or optimization history

report.primary_metric: Fixed69-class held Macro-F1 at certified regularized optimum
report.contrasts: Within each original training seed, encoder-source effect conditioned on map, map effect conditioned on source, and difference-in-differences
limits: Two encoder-training seeds reuse the same already viewed1046 held images
Exploratory conditional regularized linear readability, not pure representation-versus-optimization causal mediation
New affine head family is broader than constrained SPD-prototype heads
No automatic method promotion, extra lambda, seed, learning rate or future window
